## Technical Capabilities

- [Scalable SaaS & System Architecture](https://nofil-web-portfolio.vercel.app/expertise): Multi-tenant architectures, tenant-aware routing, PostgreSQL multi-schema isolation, and subscription billing.
- [Backend Systems & Business Automation](https://nofil-web-portfolio.vercel.app/expertise): Business-driven REST APIs, institutional workflow automation (HRM, clearance, reporting), and transactional integrity.
- [DevOps & Delivery Automation](https://nofil-web-portfolio.vercel.app/expertise): Containerization, GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines, branch deployments, and automated release workflows.
- [End-to-End Product Engineering](https://nofil-web-portfolio.vercel.app/expertise): Full application lifecycle development with TypeScript, React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, and state management.
- [Cloud Infrastructure & Reliability](https://nofil-web-portfolio.vercel.app/expertise): Kubernetes orchestration, Helm packaging, GitOps with ArgoCD, Terraform IaC, and Prometheus/Grafana observability.

## Featured Projects

- [Crontab Text Explainer](https://nofil-zahid.github.io/crontab-text-explainer/): Open-source developer tool for visually interpreting, building, and explaining cron expressions.
- [SayBack](https://www.npmjs.com/package/sayback): Retro typewriter terminal animation CLI tool published on npm with character-cycling effects.
- [ClassHub](https://nofil-web-portfolio.vercel.app/projects): Role-based learning management system with real-time chat, automated grading checks via Gemini & Copyleaks APIs, and file tracking.
- [Docly](https://nofil-web-portfolio.vercel.app/projects): Extensible rich-text document editor supporting modular blocks, keyboard shortcuts, and dynamic formatting using Slate.js.
- [DineDynaty](https://github.com/nofil-zahid/restaurant-management-system): Mobile restaurant management system built with Flutter and Firebase for reservations, tables, and inventory.
